errors.habitAction: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.notifications: There was a problem with reminder settings. Your habit was saved, and you can enable reminders again later.
errors.persistence: There was a problem saving data. Internet is not required, but please try again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.headline: A 40-day chilla toward a new habit
welcome.body: Research shows that consistent repetition helps turn intentional actions into habits. In our tradition, chilla is a 40-day period for growth and change. Let’s walk this path together.

identity.title: What kind of person do you want to become?
identity.subtitle: Habits are not just actions — they reflect the person you are becoming.
identity.label: Complete the sentence:
identity.hint: Examples: disciplined, healthy, knowledgeable, patient, kind

habit.title: Which habit will we build?
habit.subtitle: Choose one clear, small habit. Big change begins with a small step.
habit.namePlaceholder: for example: Drink 8 glasses of water every day

why.title: Why does this habit matter to you?
why.subtitle: On difficult days, this answer will give you strength. Write from the heart.
why.placeholder: for example: For my health and energy...

intention.title: When will you do this habit?
intention.subtitle: A clear plan makes the habit easier to remember: “If X happens, I will do Y.”
intention.whenPlaceholder: for example: after I wake up in the morning
intention.thenPlaceholder: for example: I will drink 1 glass of water
intention.minimalPlaceholder: for example: drink at least one sip of water
intention.minimalHint: This is the “2-minute rule”: even when you have little energy, you can still do the smallest version of your habit.

schedule.title: When should I remind you?
schedule.subtitle: A consistent time is one of the keys to habit formation.
schedule.intervalLabel: If you do not complete it, after how many minutes should I remind you again?
schedule.maxSnoozesLabel: What is the maximum number of reminders per day?
schedule.intervalHint: When you tap “Done” on a reminder, the remaining reminders for that day stop.

permissions.title: Reminder permission
permissions.subtitle: We need permission to send you a gentle reminder at your chosen time.
permissions.body: If you do not allow notifications, reminders will not work. They play an important role in building a habit.
permissions.denied: Permission was denied. You can enable it in your phone settings.

home.emptyBody: Go through onboarding to start a new 40-day chilla.
home.microEmpty: Micro habits are optional. You can add them when you are ready.

minimalCard.title: Is today feeling hard?
minimalCard.body: It does not have to be perfect. Try the easiest version:

missedCard.title: You missed one day
missedCard.body: That is normal — nobody is perfect. What matters is continuing today.

twoMissedCard.title: Has something become difficult?
twoMissedCard.body: Maybe the time does not fit, or the habit is too large. Would you like to adjust it?

progress.title: Roadmap
progress.emptyBody: No main habit has been chosen yet.

weeklyReflection.title: Weekly reflection
weeklyReflection.question: How did this week go? What helped, and what was difficult?

habit.microLimitReached: You can add up to 2 micro habits
habit.deleteConfirm: This habit and its history will be permanently deleted. Are you sure?

day1.title: First step!
day1.body: The hardest part is starting. You did it. 🌱

day7.title: 1 week!
day7.body: One week is a real win. A new path is starting to form in your mind. 🔥

day14.title: 2 weeks!
day14.body: Half a month has passed. You may already feel this habit becoming easier. ✨

day21.title: 3 weeks!
day21.body: The traditional 21-day milestone is behind you. But you keep going — the chilla continues. 🚀

day30.title: 30 days!
day30.body: A full month! This habit is becoming part of your life. Only 10 days left. 🎯

day40.title: Chilla complete!
day40.body: Over 40 days, you shaped a new quality in yourself. You did it! 🏆

settings.title: Settings
settings.clearDataConfirm: All habits and history will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

channel.name: Habit reminders
channel.description: Reminds you about your habit at the scheduled time

reminder.title: {{emoji}} {{habitName}}
reminder.body: Day {{day}} — it is time for your habit. Let’s continue today 💪

snooze.title: {{emoji}} Reminder
snooze.body: You have not completed it yet. Do you have a moment now?

morningGreeting.title: Good morning!
morningGreeting.body: Today is day {{day}} of your chilla. One more day, one more step 🌿

milestone.title: 🎉 Day {{day}}!
milestone.body: You are still moving. Losing is not falling — it is stopping.
